description: Turn auto-renew of a domain on or off (domain owner only). With auto-renew off the domain is neither renewed nor charged at the end of its term and expires. Requires confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

autoRenew.description: false = the domain is not renewed (nor charged) at the end of its term and expires.

confirm.description: Must be true to apply the change.

name: set_domain_auto_renew
title: Set Domain Auto-Renew
